row.team_price_text: Synthetic Monitoring: quantity-priced (from 10 uptime / 1 advanced check / 50 SMS), unlimited users
row.evidence: Pingdom supports single sign-on via SAML 2.0 with IdP group role mapping that creates SolarWinds Unified Login accounts automatically; no SCIM endpoint is documented and removing a user from a Pingdom organization requires contacting support.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Pingdom (SolarWinds) is priced by usage, not seats: Synthetic Monitoring by check/SMS quantity and Real User Monitoring by pageviews, both with unlimited users; Enterprise is quote-based. The rendered dollar amounts are filled by JavaScript (render.cjs failed with ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES); the page source data attributes show the smallest Synthetic bundle at $16.50/mo billed annually ($18 monthly), recorded here only as a note. SAML SSO (shared with Loggly, AppOptics, Papertrail) has no plan gate stated in the docs, so sso_plan is left null. Provisioning is JIT via SAML group role mapping only; status none. The Pingdom API has no user-management endpoints. Okta OIN app is SWA only.

plans.price_text: Starting at $…/mo, priced by quantity (lowest bundle: 10 Uptime, 1 Advanced, 50 SMS)

plans.name: Real User Monitoring
plans.price_text: Starting at $…/mo, priced by pageviews (from 100,000 pageviews)

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented. Users are invited in SolarWinds common cloud settings or created just-in-time through SAML role mapping. false rests on absence in the full Pingdom documentation sitemap (87 pages; Users and Organizations section covers only Unified Login, roles, manage users, SAML, session expiry and MFA) and in the API 3.1 reference.

rate_limits.text: Two layers of limits (short and long period) reported in Req-Limit-Short and Req-Limit-Long response headers.

user_api.notes: The Pingdom API 3.1 covers checks, maintenance windows, probes, results, transaction checks and alerting contacts/teams (notification targets). It has no endpoints for login users, roles or organization membership.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Mar. 5 2021) marks only SWA as supported; SAML, OIDC and SCIM are unchecked in the page markup.

onelogin.notes: Pingdom SAML doc links to OneLogin setup docs but describes SAML only; no provisioning.

fallbacks.notes: With SAML role mapping on, adding a user to a mapped IdP group creates a SolarWinds Unified Login account automatically; removing the user from the IdP removes access but leaves the member listed, and full removal from a Pingdom organization needs a support ticket.
